 Host & Senior Capitol Hill Reporter 
 Ali Vitali is the host of MS NOW’s Way Too Early with Ali Vitali, airing every weekday at 5am ET. She is also MS NOW’s Senior Capitol Hill Reporter based in Washington, D.C. 
Vitali has been at the forefront of covering national politics for the last decade – from the halls of Congress to the Trump and Biden White Houses, and the pivotal 2016, 2020, and 2024 presidential elections.
